note: The pipeline contract per move (CC-64): where to look for motion, what to ask Kimodo, what the motion must show. docs/motion-pipeline.md explains each field.

roll.serves: the roll out of a big drop (key X, CC-56)

prompts.roll_a: A person runs forward, drops into a forward roll on the ground with the head tucked, and springs back up to run.
prompts.roll_b: A parkour runner does a forward roll, somersaulting over one shoulder with a tucked body, then stands up running.
prompts.roll_c: A person lands from a jump and absorbs the landing with a forward roll, then gets up and keeps running.

hurt.serves: a hard landing that ends the run (outcome hurt, CC-56)

prompts.hurt_a: A person lands hard from a high drop, crumples to the ground and lies there.
prompts.hurt_b: A person falls forward onto the ground after a bad landing and stays down.

vault.serves: the vault over a step (key V, CC-44)

prompts.vault_a: A person runs at a waist-high box, plants one hand on top and swings both legs over it, then lands and keeps running.
prompts.vault_b: A parkour runner does a speed vault over a low wall with one hand on top, then runs on.

slide.serves: the slide under a head-high cannonball (key S or Down while running, CC-240)

prompts.slide_a: A person runs, then drops onto the hip and slides forward along the ground with the legs out in front, then stands up and keeps running.
prompts.slide_b: A parkour runner does a low baseball slide along the floor under an obstacle, leaning back with both legs forward, then springs up running.
prompts.slide_c: A person ducks low and slides along the ground on one leg while running fast, the body almost touching the floor, then rises and runs on.
